name: Pre-Break-In Foreknowledge (November 1971)
date_basis: PKD's letters of late November 1971; FBI letters
summary: In the days before his Santa Venetia house was broken into, PKD reports a series of premonitions and intrusive thoughts that he later interpreted as foreknowledge of the event.
description: On November 17, 1971, PKD's house in Santa Venetia, California was broken into; the file cabinets were blown open with explosives and (reportedly) cash and manuscripts were taken. In the days before, PKD reports premonitions — a sense that something was about to happen, intrusive thoughts about being watched. The break-in itself is firmly attested. The premonitions are Lane B (his own self-report, often years later). Subsequent attribution of the break-in oscillates: at various times PKD blamed the FBI, the KGB, the Black Panthers, drug dealers, his own staging, and a Vancouver-based trafficking ring.

pkd_interpretations.source: letters to friends after the break-in
pkd_interpretations.interpretation: I had recently kicked out a group of street dealers from the house; they came back to retaliate.
It was the FBI looking for evidence of subversive activity (I was friends with the Black Panthers).

pkd_interpretations.source: letter to William Sullivan FBI 1972 carbon
pkd_interpretations.interpretation: Soviet science-fiction critics including Stanislaw Lem are running an operation; Lem may not exist as an individual but is a committee front. The break-in was part of this.
I now believe I broke in myself in a fugue state, possibly to harvest the insurance.

scholar_interpretations.interpretation: Sutin records the multiple competing accounts without adjudicating, treating the break-in itself as fact and the attribution chain as mystery.
Arnold reads the chain of attribution shifts as a clinical pattern — paranoid ideation accreting around a real event.

primary_sources.excerpt: January 1975 letter to William A. Sullivan, FBI: discusses the Lem hypothesis.

contradiction_zone: yes — registered in PKDontology contradiction registry as 'November 1971 break-in'
pkd_doubt_evidence: PKD himself revises his attribution at least four times; in 1976 he allows that he may have staged it.
